name: FED-EDU Urban Dictionary
tagline: Tech jargon translated to plain talk. Nobody gatekeeps vocabulary on this block.
purpose: Every term a brother meets in the wild (docs, tutorials, job posts) with its street translation, a life example, and where it pays. This index is the card catalog; each term lives in terms/ as its own page. The search engine (search-engine.js) reads this file.
rules: Every term gets: the jargon name, the plain-talk translation, a life example, and 'where it pays' if applicable.
No term is too basic. 'What is a file' is a valid entry if a brother needed it.
Add terms by PR — one file per term, following the pattern in terms/api_endpoint.md.
Terms never talk down. 'You already know this' is banned text.
Cross-link: when one term uses another term, link it (e.g. api_endpoint links to database).
search_engine: search-engine.js reads this index and every terms/ file. Adding a term file automatically makes it searchable — no other setup.

steps: Pick the slug (short name, underscores): e.g. css_flexbox
Create terms/your_slug.md following the pattern in terms/api_endpoint.md
Add an entry to the terms list in this file with the same slug, a one_liner, and first_fifty (the first ~50 characters of your file's translation section)
PR it — new terms are fast-merge (see CONTRIBUTING.md) and earn 2 raffle tickets
